summary: Enhance data governance and compliance in financial services with our comprehensive training. Stay informed and compliant with industry regulations.
lede: Data Governance and Compliance in Financial Services helps institutions create repeatable, auditable, and resilient controls for customer, product, transaction, and risk data. Over five days, you will learn to establish ownership, define critical data elements, map lineage, monitor quality, test controls, and track remediation across business lines. The course combines governance operating models, policies, standards, reporting traceability, and audit evidence with practical use of metadata repositories, data catalogs, AI-assisted data discovery, and compliance dashboards. Workshops guide you through creating a governance charter, assigning ownership for regulatory use cases, mapping lineage for a risk report, and preparing a regulator-ready governance summary.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for financial-sector professionals who shape, manage, or rely on governed, compliant data in their daily decisions and reporting.
audience: Compliance Officer for AML, KYC, and sanctions
modules: Financial Data Governance Operating Model Design
Critical Data Elements and Data Dictionaries
Data Quality Management for Risk and Reporting
Technology, AI, and Automation in Governance
prerequisites: You should have basic familiarity with financial services processes such as customer onboarding, lending, payments, trading, insurance policy administration, or investment operations. Prior exposure to risk, compliance, IT, or data management is helpful but not mandatory. Comfort reading data models, process maps, or control descriptions will make exercises easier. No specific programming skills are required, though you should be able to work with spreadsheets and simple analytics dashboards.
